credits.title: The Riverbank
credits.overview: Izaquiel works as a cleaner in Recife, a Brazilian city intertwined with rivers and mangroves. At night, he dangerously ventures out in search of secret encounters in the mangrove forest. His world shifts when he crosses paths with Jeremias, an intriguing and magnetic fisherman.

credits.title: Nando Between Two Worlds - A Sintonia Film
credits.overview: Caught between family life and his obligations to the criminal underworld, Nando faces an impossible choice about where his true loyalties lie.

credits.title: State of Fear
credits.overview: As São Paulo erupts in an unprecedented wave of violence, a lawyer with underworld ties must strike a deal with the police to rescue her kidnapped niece.

credits.title: The Cage and the Dream
credits.overview: Vicente is a retired widower teacher who lives between lucid dreams and everyday life in the Alecrim neighborhood.

credits.title: Fim de Semana no Paraíso Selvagem
credits.overview: Rejane returns to her hometown, Paraíso, in search of answers to her brother's murder.

credits.title: Carne Mal Passada
credits.overview: Joel is part of the avid audience of police shows. Punitive content surrounds him and the boundaries of this relationship are becoming less and less clear: does he consume violence or does violence consume him?

credits.title: Boycam
credits.overview: Alexandre, 30, virtual sex professional, father of Ana Laura 7 years old, has to cope with the moral conflict between the oldest profession in the world and paternity.

credits.title: Sideral
credits.overview: In Natal, on the Brazilian north coast, the country is preparing to launch its first manned space rocket into space. A couple lives with their two children near the space centre, she is a cleaner and he is a mechanic, but she dreams of other horizons.

credits.title: It Will Get Better
credits.overview: Working as a TV host of an important political campaign for mayor, Luisa suffers with the professional relations with her co-workers. credits.overview: Bianca, a public school teacher, decides to renovate her house after receiving the news that her daughter is coming home.
